scope: Bounded local warm-ion-pump requirements, not demonstrated pump performance.
local_model: Planar two-crossing electron layer; first incoming and then diffuse1000K reflected normal speed independently follow flux-weighted Maxwellian. Aperture fraction is physical active cross section; entrance_admission separately represents neutral conductance loss through guards/baffles. eta folds ion routing and eventual captured transfer. This is a bounded column requirement, not a solved Penning-cell field or kinetic stability model.
ionization_cross_section_basis: 3.5e-21m2 near100eV from primary NASA1977Table2-1 and NIST helium ionization literature; monochromatic energy is a preparation assumption.
